account.title: Account & sessions
account.subtitle: Manage your company profile and active sessions.
account.paymentMethodSubtitle: Card on file for job payments and trip surcharges. Future bookings use this card automatically.
account.paymentMethodNone: No card on file yet. Add a card so bid accepts can charge without re-entering details.
account.paymentMethodKeepHint: This card is used automatically when you accept a carrier bid.
account.paymentMethodReplaceHint: Enter a new card below. It becomes your default for future payments.
account.profileSubtitle: Update contact details anytime. Legal / KYB changes need Ops approval.
account.profileNotReady: Company profile editing unlocks after Ops approval (onboarding complete).
account.profilePending: Change request {{status}} pending CLOX Ops review for: {{fields}}
account.selfServeHint: These fields update immediately without requiring manual verification.
account.opsGatedHint: Registered entity and headquarters changes require CLOX review. Live details stay unchanged until approved.
account.tradingNameHint: Customer-facing business name recognized by shippers and drivers (if different from legal entity name)
account.phoneHint: Primary operational contact number for dispatch and order updates
account.serviceRegionsHint: States and territories where your fleet picks up, transports, and delivers freight. You will receive and bid on loads in these regions.
account.legalNameHint: Official registered entity name as listed on the Australian Business Register (ABR) (requires CLOX verification)
account.abnHint: 11-digit registered Australian Business Number (requires CLOX verification)
account.acnHint: 9-digit company number (for Australian Pty Ltd or Ltd companies)
account.homeRegionHint: The Australian state where your main depot, legal registration, or operational headquarters is based
account.invoiceLegalNameHint: Official entity name to print on tax invoices
account.invoiceAddressHint: Physical or postal billing street address
account.gstRegisteredHint: Select if registered for Australian Goods and Services Tax
account.changeNote: Reason for change request (Note for CLOX)
account.changeNoteHint: Briefly describe why your registered legal or headquarters details need updating
account.profileChangeRequested: Change request submitted for CLOX review.
account.reviewPendingLockHint: Your profile changes are currently under review by CLOX Ops. Multiple requests cannot be submitted while a review is pending.
account.activeSessionsHint: Manage active browser sessions and devices currently logged into your account. Revoking a session will immediately sign out that device.
account.activitySubtitle: Track when profile changes were requested, review outcomes from CLOX Ops, and recent profile updates.
account.activityEmpty: No recent requests or profile updates logged yet.
account.activityEmptyHint: When you update contact details or submit legal/ABN changes for review, they will appear here with full timestamps and review notes.

documentsUpload.title: Upload & submit
documentsUpload.subtitle: Upload a document and submit a compliance case.
documentsUpload.driverSubtitle: Upload your personal licence / ID documents. Company KYB is submitted by your carrier.
documentsUpload.driverHint: Drivers cannot open a company compliance case. To activate for trips, complete licence + NHVR on
documentsUpload.driverLicenceRedirectHint: Uploading a licence document here only saves the file in your document storage. To renew your licence, update your expiry date, and reactivate your profile to take trips, please submit your renewal through the Driver Licence & Profile page.
documentsUpload.submittedMessage: Submitted case {{id}}… → company {{companyStatus}}. Open Compliance queue as Super/State.
documentsUpload.errorNoCompany: No company linked to this account — cannot upload yet.
documentsUpload.errorSubmitNotAllowed: This role cannot submit a company compliance case.
documentsUpload.companyDocsDesc: Public liability, cargo insurance, DG licence, and business registry.
documentsUpload.driverDocsDesc: Driver licences, NHVR certificates, and identity verification.
documentsUpload.fleetDocsDesc: Vehicle registrations, roadworthiness certificates, and inspections.
